guide:
Budgets और Controls

हर Problem: क्या करना है → Steps → Entry Table → ✅ Check (उत्तर-कुंजी से मिलान)।

सबसे पहले — Budget की तैयारी

  • F11 (Features) → Maintain Budgets and Controls = Yes।
  • Gateway → Create → Budget: Name, Period (From–To), Under (Primary), और Budget Type चुनें (Ledger-wise / Group-wise)।
  • जिस Ledger या Group पर Budget लगाना है उसे चुनें → Budget Amount भरें → On (Nett Transactions / Closing Balance)।
  • Controls के लिए Budget Alter में Alt+C जैसा विकल्प या Ledger/Group की Budget Control सेटिंग: Ignore / Warn / Stop।
  • असली खर्च के Vouchers (Payment F5) डालें।
  • जाँच: Gateway → Display More Reports → Statements of Accounts → Budget Variance (या Trial Balance में F12 से Budget Columns)।
याद रखें

Variance = Actual − Budget।

Expense में Actual < Budget → Favourable; Actual > Budget → Adverse।

Sales में Actual > Budget → Favourable।

Budget का Period Voucher की तारीख़ों से मिलना चाहिए।

problems.title: 12-Month Group-wise  &  Ledger-wise Budget — Factory + Office Expenses
problems.q:
🔴 Expert

Opening Balances: Cash ₹ 10,50,000; Bank ₹ 5,00,000. Create a Group Budget on 'Factory Expenses' (with Factory Lighting, Factory Rent, Factory Wages ledgers under it) and separate Ledger Budgets for Meal Expenses, Stationery and Advertisement. Pay the first 6 months (April–September) by Cash and the last 6 months (October–March) by Bank, using the month-wise actual figures.

ExpenseAnnual Budget (₹)Total Actual (Apr–Mar) (₹)
Factory Lighting (under Factory Expenses)—69,500
Factory Rent (under Factory Expenses)—98,500
Factory Wages (under Factory Expenses)—72,700
Factory Expenses — Group Total2,50,0002,40,700
Meal Expenses50,00047,400
Stationery5,0004,400
Advertisement20,00019,100
problems.hint:
• Opening: Cash ₹10,50,000; Bank ₹5,00,000।
  • Create → Group: "Factory Expenses" (Under Indirect Expenses)। इसके नीचे Ledgers: Factory Lighting, Factory Rent, Factory Wages।
  • Create → Budget (1 Apr से 31 Mar): Factory Expenses (Group) = ₹2,50,000; Meal Expenses = ₹50,000; Stationery = ₹5,000; Advertisement = ₹20,000।
  • अप्रैल से सितंबर तक Payment Voucher में Cash और अक्टूबर से मार्च तक Bank चुनें।
  • Group Budget Variance में Factory Expenses एक Group के रूप में दिखेगा; बाकी तीन Ledger-wise।

problems.title: Sales Budget vs Actual — Variance

🟢 Basic
